lines: GTA 6 may have cost more than India's Moon landing. Thirteen times.
Analysts say over a billion dollars.
Rockstar says that's wrong. And won't say what's right.
First, the people. Rockstar has four thousand seven hundred and eleven employees.
Say each one costs a hundred grand a year. That's almost half a billion dollars. Every. Single. Year.
Then they built fake Florida. Their first research trip to Miami? Twenty fifteen.
Every street, every palm tree, every trash can. Made by hand.
Then the actors. Mocap suits for every walk, punch and stumble.
Bloomberg says they even argued about how you buy a beer. Grab it from the fridge? Walk it to the counter? Pay?
Then someone leaked ninety clips. Rockstar says the cleanup cost five million dollars.
And marketing? A Vice City sign on the Miami Heat's arena. Reportedly nine hundred seventy-five thousand dollars. For one sign.
Crazy? Analysts expect GTA 6 to make three billion dollars in four months.
You don't have a billion dollars.
So sketch it, and Vi3W turns it into a 3D model in seconds.
